scope: Independent read-only review of atomic position batches, Rust byte-patch/bridge validation, current-source geometry receipts, batch GUI ownership/selection/images, shared parent completion and editor source apply. Eight current-source probe groups ran under pinned Node 24.20.0; UI and browser evidence is separately attributed. No installed window or Android/device acceptance.

findings.title: Ignore an opening failure after the originating preview loses ownership
findings.rootCause: The initial batch-controller catch guarded epoch and disposal but omitted isCurrent(), so a late helper rejection could alert after the source preview closed or changed.
findings.fix: Dispose any candidate and reset owned partial state, then ignore a stale epoch, destroyed controller or failed source-owner predicate before alerting.

regression.test: an asynchronous opening failure loses its alert and cannot disturb a closed originating preview
regression.scope: UI-controller harness with real helper/Rust history and outline; renderer spy; system Node 24.21.0

reviewedBoundaries: Same-placement new overrides are aggregated before edits; absent, empty and existing containers yield deterministic author order regardless of request order.
Exact final UTF-8 budget permits one target shrink to offset another target growth; no intermediate recipe or partial patch is returned.
Duplicate/unknown targets and any local/world coordinate failure reject all changes before history mutation; redo, dirty and untouched actors are preserved.
Fractional unmoved axes retain authored local values; returning a target to its initial world position omits it from the proposal.
All six size-aware alignments use the shared Rust geometry and one undo step; 100-step truncation/reset and closed-session guards remain intact.
Host preparation snapshots source/proposal before digest and recomputes every stable identity, canonical order, changed path and exact afterContent; forged/stale receipts fail.
Batch UI rejects unfinished and silently modified active coordinate fields before selecting/moving/alignment/check/apply; owned image canvases are cloned and released.
Shared parent completion authenticates the complete canonical proposal and the same result receipt, accepting detached child submissions and the expected source-token advance.

Memory source application guards document/path/baseline/content/load token and owner before and after both digest and full patch preparation; ordinary save still owns persistence and conflict handling.

Independent position capability protects older cores; five old single helper/controllers/browser harness sources are byte preserved, while the changed shared parent/runtime require separate actual regressions.
